prompts.prompt: Where is the customer experience leaking across channels?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: 411,768 contacts; 27,327 open more than 48 hours. The highest share open too long is Email (13%). Public data not yet loaded.

prompts.prompt: How much comes back after Cora, as a call or a complaint?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: Cora took 123,184 contacts and resolved 91,192; 21,445 are still open. Calls: 182,715. The 7-day return to a call or complaint needs Cora logs joined to call records inside the bank.

prompts.prompt: How many complaints could go to the Financial Ombudsman Service?
prompts.answer: As at 2026-11-12: 15 complaints are within 10 days of the final-response deadline, 296 are past it with no final response, 1,872 are unhappy with the final response, and 2,216 have been referred. Rules: 8 weeks; payment services 15 business days (35 in exceptional cases). Eligibility and risk only; LisN does not predict who will refer.

prompts.prompt: Which journey is leaking most customers this week?
prompts.answer: Everyday banking: 5,994 of the 17,489 switching-intent contacts in the last 7 days came after a negative contact at that stage. Next: Service requests (1,279) and Open (802); 8,862 had no earlier negative contact. Internal, illustrative.

prompts.prompt: What is the Consumer Duty evidence for financially vulnerable customers?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: 103,330 contacts from customers flagged financially vulnerable; 13,791 open, 1,208 with no reply after 48 hours. Consumer Duty outcomes: Products and services · price and value · consumer understanding · consumer support.
